Case reference: 2014005607.CaseDesc: Eleanor Eatha Parkinson-Jenkins was last seen on Monday March 1, 1982, in the suburb of Saint-Bruno-de Montarville, in Longueil, Québec. Eleanor was reported missing by her family and had been ill for the previous six months. Eleanor usually spent her days in bed or never went out alone, and would normally leave a note if she left. The day she went missing, Eleanor left her residence on foot and would have left after the departure of her husband, and did not take her purse with her. She is a originally from Ottawa, Ontario.

Case reference: 2020006644.CaseDesc: On July 6, 1980, Andrew Jenkins was seen for the last time in Toronto, Ontario. During the time of his disappearance, Andrew may have been despondent.

Scar: Left Side Of Neck, Two inches

Case reference: 2014005032.CaseDesc: Edward Dufresne was last seen on April 12, 1993 at his home in Ste-Félicité, Quebec and was reported missing by his neighbour. Edward lived alone in a small house on Route 132, and he was known to regularly walk along the roads, pick mussels by the water, and go hunt for small game in the forest.

Chain: Silver, Aluminum, Stainless Steel, With keys tied to a string

Case reference: 2005006599.CaseDesc:
On September 18, 1978, the body of an unidentified man was found in the Toronto Harbour of Lake Ontario. His post-mortem weight was 163lbs and his length was measured at 5'10", however, these measurements may not represent his actual living weight and height due to post-mortem changes noted at autopsy.
Staining on his teeth suggest that he may have been a smoker. It is estimated that he had been in the water for several weeks.

Teeth: Stained, Overbite & several amalgam fillings. Several teeth lost/extracted during life; lower right lateral incisor being most obvious.

Case reference: 2006006699.CaseDesc: Eric Larsfolk and John McCormick were last seen playing at the McCormick farm in Caledon. They have not been seen since.
